source: 2025 IEPR Gas Rate Forecast workbook, efiling tn=264063, sheet 'PG&E Res'
note: CEC PG&E residential gas DELIVERED price ($/therm) by scenario (Demand x RR-recovery), 2025-2050, with commodity/transportation split + Demand (=Sales) and Revenue Requirement. The 'GT AAFS 2.5 Demand Flat RR' scenario = the ~$103/therm death-spiral figure. 'Pruning RR' = curtailed gas investment (managed decline); 'Flat/Constant RR' = BAU.

citation.basis_note: Delivered/commodity/transportation are REAL 2024$ — the workbook's 'Commodity Prices' sheet is headed '2024$/Therm', and its values equal 'PG&E Res' col F. projected_rate_model._cec_gas_index() inflates to nominal (GDP deflator) so gas shares the nominal internal basis; the canonical reporting basis is real 2024$ via to_real().
